# FOUNDATION CONSUMER HEALTHCARE ANNOUNCES SENIOR LEADERSHIP CHANGES FOLLOWING STRATEGIC REPOSITIONING INTO WOMEN'S HEALTH

* * *

## News provided by

**Foundation Consumer Healthcare**

Aug 04, 2026, 09:05 ET

_Following successful portfolio streamlining, Foundation Consumer Healthcare sharpens category focus on the high-growth women's health market with two senior leadership appointments. Rupa Bahri, former Haleon executive, has been appointed CEO. Founder and current CEO Greg Bradley will assume the role of chairman of the board._

PITTSBURGH , Aug. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH) today announced the appointment of Rupa Bahri as chief executive officer.
The appointment marks the culmination of a strategic transformation to establish FCH as a pure play leader dedicated to the women's health sector. The announcement follows the completion of a targeted divestiture of the company's over-the-counter (OTC) wellness brands to Prestige Consumer Healthcare in June 2026.

Continue Reading

Foundation Consumer Healthcare

"I am honored to join Foundation Consumer Healthcare at such a transformative time," said Rupa Bahri, incoming CEO. "The team has an iconic brand in Plan B, and we have an opportunity to create an exceptional platform. Women's health represents one of the most dynamic and crucial opportunities in health care today, and I look forward to working with the team to deliver innovative solutions and build a market-leading business."

Bahri succeeds Greg Bradley, who co-founded FCH and has led it as CEO since its inception in 2014.

# Former Haleon president, Rupa Bahri, joins Foundation Consumer Healthcare as CEO

Rupa Bahri has been appointed CEO of Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH).

She brings more than two decades of global health care leadership, most recently, as the seven-year Canadian president of Haleon, home to brands such as Advil, Centrum, and Sensodyne. She previously led major U.S. portfolio turnarounds at Novartis Consumer and GSK Consumer Healthcare. She began her career in R&D engineering at Medtronic before honing her strategic expertise at McKinsey & Company.

She succeeds Greg Bradley, who co-founded FCH and has led it as CEO since its inception in 2014. He will transition to chairman of the board.

Foundation Consumer Healthcare Appoints Rupa Bahri as CEO, Refocuses on Women’s Health

## What to know

* Rupa Bahri has been appointed CEO of Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH), effective August 4, 2026.
* The appointment follows FCH's strategic repositioning and divestiture of OTC wellness brands, establishing it as a pure-play women's health company.
* Former CEO and co-founder Greg Bradley will transition to chairman of the board for FCH.
* Bahri brings over two decades of global healthcare leadership, including experience as Canadian president of Haleon and roles at Novartis and GSK Consumer Healthcare.

Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH) has appointed Rupa Bahri as its new chief executive officer, marking a significant strategic transformation for the company. This leadership change follows FCH’s successful divestiture of its over-the-counter (OTC) wellness brands in June 2026. The move establishes FCH as a dedicated leader focused entirely on the women’s health sector.

Bahri’s appointment culminates FCH’s efforts to streamline its portfolio and sharpen its focus on the high-growth women’s health market. She expressed honor in joining FCH at a “transformative time,” recognizing the opportunity to build an exceptional platform around its iconic brand, Plan B. The company views women’s health as a dynamic and crucial area within healthcare.

Greg Bradley, who co-founded FCH and served as CEO since 2014, will transition to chairman of the board.
During his 12-year tenure, Bradley scaled FCH from a startup to a top-10 OTC healthcare company, overseeing its recent strategic portfolio optimization.

A professional woman in a business suit stands confidently in an office setting Rupa Bahri takes the helm at Foundation Consumer Healthcare.

## A New Focus on Women’s Health

FCH’s strategic repositioning into women’s health follows a targeted divestiture of its non-core wellness brands. This move allows the company to concentrate its resources and expertise on delivering innovative solutions for women. Bahri emphasized the goal to build a market-leading business within this specialized sector.

Bradley noted that with FCH’s focus now “fully anchored on women’s health,” Bahri is “exceptionally qualified” to lead the company into its next phase of growth. He expressed excitement about partnering with her in his new role as chairman.

## Bahri’s Extensive Healthcare Background
Rupa Bahri brings more than two decades of global healthcare leadership experience to her new role. Her track record includes driving strategic growth, scaling operations, executing complex mergers and acquisitions, and building high-performing organizations.

A diverse group of professional women collaborate and discuss work in a modern office Collaboration drives strategic growth at Foundation Consumer Healthcare.

Most recently, Bahri served for seven years as the Canadian president of Haleon, a major consumer healthcare company. During her time there, she achieved record-breaking growth in market share, profitability, and operational efficiency. Bahri also led significant U.S. portfolio turnarounds at Novartis Consumer and GSK Consumer Healthcare. Her career began in R&D engineering at Medtronic before she transitioned to strategic consulting at McKinsey & Company. Her background supports the focus on [women advancement](https://herforward.
com/executive-leadership-programs-emphasize-network-building-over-skills-alone-for-women-advancement/) in leadership.

## Leadership Transition and Future Vision

The transition of leadership signifies FCH’s commitment to its new direction. Bradley’s move to chairman of the board will allow him to continue contributing to the company’s strategic oversight. He also serves as Chairman of the Board of the Consumer Healthcare Products Association (CHPA).

Bahri’s vision for FCH involves leveraging its existing iconic brand, Plan B, to create a robust platform in women’s health. This strategic appointment positions FCH to capitalize on what it identifies as one of the most dynamic opportunities in healthcare today. This also aligns with a growing trend of [women executives](https://herforward.com/sheknows-platform-and-chief-awards-mark-shift-in-senior-women-executive-development/) taking on senior roles.
Her appointment is a notable example of a [woman in healthcare leadership](https://herforward.com/four-rwjbarnabas-women-executives-named-to-beckers-2026-hospital-leader-list/) .

The appointment of Rupa Bahri as CEO, combined with the company’s refined focus, signals a dedicated approach to innovation and market leadership in the women’s health sector, as reported by [Morningstar](https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20260804da18485/foundation-consumer-healthcare-announces-senior-leadership-changes-following-strategic-repositioning-into-womens-health) and [AOL](https://www.aol.com/articles/foundation-consumer-healthcare-announces-senior-130500000.html) .

## Frequently asked questions

* ### Who is the new CEO of Foundation Consumer Healthcare?
  
  Rupa Bahri has been appointed as the new chief executive officer of Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH). Her appointment was announced on August 4, 2026.
* ### What is Foundation Consumer Healthcare's new strategic focus?
Foundation Consumer Healthcare has undergone a strategic transformation to become a pure-play leader dedicated to the women’s health sector. This follows the divestiture of its OTC wellness brands.
* ### What is Greg Bradley's new role at FCH?
  
  Greg Bradley, who co-founded and led FCH as CEO since 2014, will now serve as chairman of the board for Foundation Consumer Healthcare.
* ### What experience does Rupa Bahri bring to her new role?
  
  Rupa Bahri has over two decades of global healthcare leadership experience, including serving as Canadian president of Haleon and holding leadership positions at Novartis Consumer and GSK Consumer Healthcare.
* ### When did Foundation Consumer Healthcare divest its wellness brands?
  
  Foundation Consumer Healthcare completed the targeted divestiture of its over-the-counter wellness brands to Prestige Consumer Healthcare in June 2026.

# FOUNDATION CONSUMER HEALTHCARE ANNOUNCES SENIOR LEADERSHIP CHANGES FOLLOWING STRATEGIC REPOSITIONING INTO WOMEN'S HEALTH

[Associated Press](https://apnews.com/)

Updated Tue, August 4, 2026 at 1:08 PM UTC

0

Following successful portfolio streamlining, Foundation Consumer Healthcare sharpens category focus on the high-growth women's health market with two senior leadership appointments. Rupa Bahri, former Haleon executive, has been appointed CEO. Founder and current CEO Greg Bradley will assume the role of chairman of the board.

PITTSBURGH, Aug.
4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH) today announced the appointment of Rupa Bahri as chief executive officer. The appointment marks the culmination of a strategic transformation to establish FCH as a pure play leader dedicated to the women's health sector. The announcement follows the completion of a targeted divestiture of the company's over-the-counter (OTC) wellness brands to Prestige Consumer Healthcare in June 2026.

"I am honored to join Foundation Consumer Healthcare at such a transformative time," said Rupa Bahri, incoming CEO. "The team has an iconic brand in Plan B, and we have an opportunity to create an exceptional platform. Women's health represents one of the most dynamic and crucial opportunities in health care today, and I look forward to working with the team to deliver innovative solutions and build a market-leading business."

Bahri succeeds Greg Bradley, who co-founded FCH and has led it as CEO since its inception in 2014.
